steps.content: The fierce battle eases down, as if the warring sides have distanced themselves from each other. You can't see it, but you feel it everywhere. Suddenly, you hear a voice in your head.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: You... are the same as her...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: O holder of the shackles... You have been awakened just like us... Yet you're able to devour us...

Its voice is weak, yet shows an iron will to live. It seems that the closer it is to death, the better it can hide. This perseverance is what made it able to survive for eight years after it got cut in half.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who am I the same as? Who took what from you? Where is she now?

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Huff...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Haha... somewhere. She's waiting...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: That arrogant devil... When it becomes chaotic, tyrannical, mad, and unrestrained on the surface, she'll come... to finish the reaping, as she always has...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Don't worry, very soon... As long as I kill you... I'll have the power to take revenge on her...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: ...This time... I'm going to kill all of you, one by one!
Something with the suffocating force of another dimension is coming towards you! You try to block it with your shackles, but the moment you cast the shackles—
Space starts to warp. This is no longer the Executive Committee's detention center. As the huge half of the Corpus appears before your eyes, the heavy contamination suffocates you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=32>Perhaps due to the Ring Master's power, the two half-bodies, one dead and one alive, are still somehow deeply connected. The living half is out there spreading Mania and devouring humans' spiritual energy. The resulting contamination is transferred to the dead half.</size>
Is this... the dead half of the Corpus at the bottom of BR-002?

No, it's just a blurry apparition. You want to use your shackles to check if your surroundings are real or not, but at that moment, a blue light flashes, and an almost instinctive fear makes you flinch.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: ...Haha... Haha... Standing there like a fool...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: So... you get scared, too...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: You'll be the first one to die here!!

-Chief?
-Chief!
Chief is really down there. I can feel it!
You hear familiar voices. Your shackles clearly feel the presence of two others. It's Hella and Hecate! They followed you here?
No, they're not in the detention center. They're in the mine, above the dead Corpus. The two places are connected via the two halves of the Corpus, and you can sense each other through the shackles.
You see the Nightmare above you cloaked in shadows, desperately trying to penetrate the precipitation pool to find you. Its intrusion is making the Corpseborne panic.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Go away! Not again!
A huge amount of contamination rushes toward the Nightmare, while you instinctively make a move at the same time.
Sharp red light zips through the air and shatters the contamination entangling the Nightmare, then blasts through all the barriers above.
